Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct and sudden drop in the value of U (mm) starting around x=670. The data fluctuates between roughly -10 and +5 for the majority of the series (x=0 to x=660), but then plunges to values between -20 and -30. This entire segment represents an anomaly compared to the rest of the distribution.

The points of anomalies are:
[670, 671, 672, 673, 674, 675, 676, 677, 678, 679, 680, 681, 682, 683, 684, 685, 686, 687, 688, 689, 690, 691, 692, 693, 694, 695, 696, 697, 698, 699, 700, 701, 702, 703, 704, 705, 706, 707, 708, 709, 710, 711, 712, 713, 714, 715, 716, 717, 718, 719, 720, 721, 722, 723, 724, 725, 726, 727, 728, 729]
